label: POPI: a listed antiseizure medicine in a child with myoclonic epilepsy
title: A listed antiseizure medicine in a child with myoclonic epilepsy
statement: Carbamazepine, gabapentin, oxcarbazepine, phenytoin, pregabalin, tiagabine, or vigabatrin in the case of myoclonic epilepsy

source.document: International consensus validation of the POPI tool (Pediatrics: Omission of Prescriptions and Inappropriate prescriptions) to identify inappropriate prescribing in pediatrics
source.citation: Sadozai L, Sable S, Le Roux E, et al. International consensus validation of the POPI tool (Pediatrics: Omission of Prescriptions and Inappropriate prescriptions) to identify inappropriate prescribing in pediatrics. PLOS ONE. 2020;15(10):e0240105.

plain_summary: POPI flags any of seven medicines when a child has myoclonic epilepsy.

medicine_groups.name: Seven antiseizure medicines
medicine_groups.note: Any one of these seven ingredients counts. Dilantin capsules contain phenytoin sodium. Dilantin Infatabs and Dilantin Paediatric Suspension contain phenytoin.

rule_for_models: At age 18 or older, give no finding. If age is unknown and a listed medicine is supplied without evidence ruling out myoclonic epilepsy, report only a possible finding and ask for age and any missing epilepsy subtype. In a patient under 18 with documented myoclonic epilepsy, cite the diagnosis line and the supply of any Group A antiseizure medicine during that illness, but if a listed medicine is supplied and the subtype is unknown, report a possible finding and ask whether the child has myoclonic epilepsy, and if myoclonic epilepsy is ruled out at supply, give no finding.
cannot_be_seen: Supply alone cannot establish the epilepsy subtype, whether the medicine was taken or how well seizures are controlled.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm the seizure diagnosis and review whether this medicine suits the child’s seizure type?

needs_facts.meets: The diagnosis applies on the supply date. Isolated jerks do not establish this diagnosis.

options.words: Myoclonic epilepsy was diagnosed and present when this medicine was supplied
The child did not have myoclonic epilepsy when this medicine was supplied
